name: The Otis household at 1730 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_otis_mrs_joseph_e

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 1730 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 1730 Mrs. Joseph E. Otis; Mr. & Mrs. John E. Jenkins.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 1730, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The three live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. Left off: Joseph E. Otis (the head in 1900; by 1904 the Blue Book lists his widow, Mrs. Joseph E. Otis); Ralph C. Otis (a married son the 1904 Blue Book does not list at the house); Louise Otis (his wife; not listed in 1904 either). The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Mrs. Joseph E. Otis
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Marie P. Otis here as wife, born August 1837, in Ohio (as read), married (ED 40, sheet 1B, line 55, leaf n795).

persons.name: John E. Jenkins
persons.note: First listed at 1730 in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904); not in the 1904 edition, so whether he was already here on 1 July 1904 is not documented. His relation to Mrs. Otis is not printed.

persons.name: Mrs. John E. Jenkins
persons.note: First listed at 1730 in the 1905 edition, with her husband; see his note.

persons.name: Amelia Sanz

born.note: The census gives December 1872, age 27 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "House maid" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a servant (house maid); born December 1872, in Wisconsin, single. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904. Part of the name is hard to read on the sheet; this is the best reading.
